name: Ellen Kuras
bio: Ellen Kuras is a director and cinematographer whose work spans narrative films, documentaries, music films and commercials. Her cinematography includes Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind; she directed the documentary The Betrayal / Nerakhoon.

name: Garth Davis
bio: Garth Davis works across commercials, television and feature films. His feature debut was Lion, and he co-directed the television series Top of the Lake with Jane Campion. His commercial work includes films for Xbox and Coca-Cola.
